families.name: reports
families.note: Monthly/weekly/audit report bodies rendered by render_template.py (stdlib string.Template). Data comes from the reporting skills as a flat JSON dict of $key -> str.

families.name: content
families.renderer: skill-side ({{UPPER_SNAKE}} replacement by new-blog / revision / faq-block / upload-instructions content skills)
families.note: On-page content artifacts (HTML/MD) filled by the content-generation skills, NOT render_template.py. Tokens are {{UPPER_SNAKE}}.
